typography.font_strategy: Cabinet Grotesk for strong, architectural headings. IBM Plex Sans for technical, tabular, and highly readable body text, especially critical for the Dashboard.
features: Use 'tabular-nums' class on all figures, metrics, and KPI tiles.
No Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk.

colors.strategy: True Grey base (not pure black) to reduce eye strain, combined with a single strong 'Electric Deep Blue' accent. Minimal gradients. NO purple gradients on white.

spacing_rhythm.strategy: Apply these directly to Tailwind configuration extensions. Generous padding. Minimal container crowding.

marketing_page.layout: Glassmorphism nav, backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60. Logo left, Nav center, Lang Switcher + CTA right.
grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Left (col-span-5): Promise + Proof + CTA. Right (col-span-7): Animated Engine Centerpiece.
Full width seamless marquee using 'react-fast-marquee' with transparent geometric logos.
grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2. Left sticky text (Audience pain), right scrolling checkbox-list style.
Vertical timeline or 3-column layout. Massive numbers.
Bento Grid, 3 cards per row. Subtle hover lift.
Split view comparison panels. Left side standard SEO, Right side AEO/GEO visibility.
Masonry or horizontal scrolling cards. Faces + Rating Block.
Accordion via CSS grid-template-rows 0fr->1fr. Answer-first logic.
Minimalist grid of professional portraits on dark background.
Massive typography, Electric Blue background container.
Strict columns, high contrast. Huge brand mark at the bottom.

dashboard.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar. Contains Logo, Live Clock component, Language Dropdown (EN/DE), Nav Links (Overview, Traffic, Engagement, Conversions, Performance, Audience).
dashboard.main_content: True grey background. Layered elevation cards with --pm-surface-raised and --pm-border-subtle.
dashboard.kpi_tiles: Grid of 3-4 tiles. Large tabular-nums, subtle sparklines.
dashboard.charts: Recharts wrapper. Use dark-mode safe colors. Lines stroke='#0047FF'. Add custom tooltip with glassmorphism.

engine_centerpiece.tech: HTML5 <canvas> with requestAnimationFrame or Three.js (React Three Fiber).
engine_centerpiece.visuals: A central glowing blue sphere representing the User's Brand. Surrounding orbiting rings and particles representing Answer Engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity). Data streams flowing into the center, lighting it up. Represents processing AEO/GEO data.

surface_styles.cards: Borderless or 1px subtle border (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)), minimal box-shadow, reliance on background color shift for elevation.

animations.revealText: Masked lines sliding up. Ensure overflow is hidden on text wrapper to avoid clipped descenders.
animations.cta_hover: Darker fill sliding in from left via ::before transform.
animations.accordion: grid-template-rows: 0fr -> 1fr transition for smooth height animation.

accessibility.motion_preference: Must respect prefers-reduced-motion media query by disabling continuous animations (like the canvas engine) or reducing to simple fades.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must include 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='cta-book-demo').

media.image_strategy: Use dark, professional, high-contrast imagery to match the sleek Swiss/futuristic aesthetic.

backgrounds.category: Hero or Footer Background Overlay (Moody Swiss Alps)

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a dual-app structure: a marketing one-page site and a dashboard inside the same React app, separated by react-router.
Implement the animated engine using <canvas> or React Three Fiber directly. It must visually convey AI Answer Engine data processing.
Ensure 'mobile-first 360px' logic. The hero must be fully visible above-the-fold without scrolling.
Use Lucide icons for standard UI, but maintain a sharp, thin line weight.
Set up Tailwind variables linked to --pm-* custom properties.
Do NOT use pure black or pure white gradients. Rely on true grey and solid dark blue.
Integrate recharts for the 6 dashboard pages. Implement loading states (skeleton) and empty states.
Implement language switching state (EN/DE) across both Marketing and Dashboard using a simple Context or i18n library.
Use Javascript (.js/.jsx) as standard. If the repo is explicitly set up for TypeScript, use .tsx, but default to standard React ES6 conventions.
Do not use generic font names like Inter, Roboto, Space Grotesk. Embed Google Fonts for Cabinet Grotesk and IBM Plex Sans.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create depth with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
DO NOT apply 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transition properties to prevent breaking transforms.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern interactive button styles with specific :hover states.
Never use AI assistant Emojis for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never use placeholder URLs. Use the provided image URLs strictly.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for Headers or dropdown menus over content. Always use solid or blurred backdrops.
